contract_plain_english: The usual Riemann problem specifies a hyperbolic equation with constant initial states on the two sides of x = 0 (printed p. 5, Section 1.2.1, equation (1.11)). The selected passage extends this setup to permit a discontinuity in the medium at that same location as well as the initial-data discontinuity (printed p. 8, Section 1.4). It does not specify a material-parameter formula, interface conditions, or values exactly at the interface. The subsequent discussion of wave decomposition, reflection, and transmission is a separate claim (printed p. 8, immediately following sentence).
